beats.narration_text: Salut — this is Liam, in for Komal. Quiet luxury hid the logo. The comments did not. Today: is quiet luxury still quiet — and how AI sentiment on social comments helps a brand read the talk without confusing it for the clothes.

show.event: RESULT: searches ≠ sales · shoppers shrank · polarity ≠ quiet

props.command: Is quiet luxury still quiet, and how can AI sentiment on social comments help a brand read the talk without confusing it for the clothes?
output: Searches spiked. They are not sales.
Sentiment reads comments. It does not prove quiet.

beats.narration_text: Why this is live. April 2023. Karen Millen read Google. Old-money style: 25,000 searches a month. Quiet luxury: 6,100. Stealth wealth: 2,200. Quiet luxury searches were up 373 percent in that month. A search is not a customer.

shot.prompt: Drawn search-volume bars — not a screenshot of Google Trends.

qc.sparse_reason: Two sourced counts on cream; the gap is the teaching, not missing type.

beats.narration_text: The shopper count moved the other way. Bain, November 2026: personal luxury goods customers — 330 million in 2025, about 315 million in 2026. The talk can stay loud while fewer people buy the goods.

shot.prompt: Drawn shopper counts 330M to 315M — not a Bain slide photograph.

beats.narration_text: So brands listen. Meltwater, 2025: among teams that already listen, 77 percent watch reputation. 52 percent track awareness. Brandwatch read over 718 million mentions across 347 brands in six months. A person cannot. That is why the model sits on the comments.

shot.prompt: Drawn 77 / 52 listening-goal bars — not a Meltwater dashboard.

beats.narration_text: What the model returns is not the position. Positive, negative, neutral. A comment can be positive about a costume. Negative about a price. Neutral and still loud. Polarity is not quiet. A person still names which object they will act on.

props.caption: A score of positive is not proof the brand is still quiet.

items.label: Negative
items.sub: Can be the price, not the code.

qc.sparse_reason: ClaudeVerdictArtifact is a single page card on the cream stage; house padding is the layout, not missing content.

beats.narration_text: Let's recap with Claude. Quiet on the garment is not quiet in the comments. Searches spiked; they are not sales. Shoppers shrank while the talk stayed. Sentiment helps a brand read reputation at a scale a person cannot. It does not prove the brand is still quiet.
